desc:
CHEX MIX: Snack Mix loaded with fun, flavorful shapes of Chex, pretzels, sweet vanilla flavored swirl cookies, and breadsticks

SWEET AND SALTY SNACK MIX: With corn Chex, wheat Chex, pretzels, mini vanilla flavored breadsticks, plus sweet vanilla flavored swirl cookies, you'll get crunchy and delicious all in one

PARTY FAVORITE: Endless taste and texture combinations make it the perfect party mix snack for get-togethers of all shapes and sizes; Not your standard pub mix, trail mix, or bar snack

EASY AND PORTABLE: Stock your pantry with this delicious snack to share with friends and family

CONTAINS: One 8 oz bag of Chex Mix Sweet and Salty Honey Nut Snack Mix
features:
Features

Sweet & Salty Flavor Combo

Combines the classic savory crunch of Chex Mix with a touch of sweet honey and nut flavoring.

Multi-Texture Snack

Features a variety of textures—crispy Chex pieces, crunchy pretzels, and sweet cookie bits.

Compared to traditional chips, it offers significantly less fat per serving.

Benefits

Satisfies Multiple Cravings

The perfect snack if you’re torn between sweet and salty—this mix gives you both.

Ideal for parties, family movie nights, or road trips.

The inclusion of sweet cookie pieces makes it especially popular with children.
ingredients: Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Whole Wheat, Sugar, Vegetable Oil (soybean, high oleic soybean, high oleic canola and/or palm). Contains 2% or less of: Brown Sugar, Salt, Dextrose, Baking Soda, Yeast, Dried Molasses, Malted Barley Extract, Barley Malt Syrup, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Distilled Monoglycerides, Maltodextrin, Yellow Corn Flour, Trisodium Phosphate, Dried Honey, Calcium Carbonate, Nonfat Milk, Soy Lecithin. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
